system.description: The Surveillance Tagger is a tiny, unassuming tube containing a Fine sized dart and a compressed air canister. When fired, the dart attaches itself to the target with a combination of adhesives and magnetism and activates a homing beacon. The homing beacon has a range of 1 kilometer and enough power to transmit for 40 hours.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
